review_kind: Independent non-author transfer and instruction review against eleven user-provided scientific-figure references

checks.observation: Origins, research results and award identities remain unverified; static GIF frame count is stated correctly. Original images are not distributed.
All eleven image roles are covered by ten purpose-based entries; images 10 and 11 share constrained/set geometry, while their exact algorithms are not inferred.
Domain, class and seen/unseen state are assigned separable visual channels; schematic distances, areas and enclosures are not promoted to statistical meaning.
Taxonomy is distinguished from causality and overlapping methods need not be forced into exclusive leaves. Ensemble aggregation is tied to the actual implemented rule.

Counts use a suitable sequential palette; zero and missing are separated. Composition requires a known denominator and appropriate mutually exclusive, exhaustive categories; multi-label frequencies are not normalized to a misleading 100%.
Feedback arrows carry objects and time indices. Action filtering does not automatically imply reward modification, and Safe-layer labels are not treated as safety proof.
The unknown function/set definitions in image 11 remain explicitly unknown; no projection, reachability or safety algorithm is fabricated.
The branch keeps current paper structure, model, backend, project style, parent-managed delegation and existing human gates. It adds no controller, role or compulsory chart count.
Readers load only relevant 1-2 entries. Abstract mechanism diagrams remain readable in 2D without removing the prior conditional-3D preference for actual third variables.
Script routes and manifest entries are being integrated; this review does not certify their execution, exports or final visual quality.

findings.observation: In meta-learning a collection named meta-test/query can participate in the training update. The reference also shows final unseen-domain evaluation; these are different roles.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly say that meta-test/query naming alone is not independent-test evidence; distinguish update participation from outer held-out evaluation.

reference_images.private_identity_and_visual_notes: Retained outside the public repository; no source-image paths or bytes in this report

scope_limits: This is a static guidance review, not an algorithm, literature, scientific result or safety verification.
No generated chart or manuscript page has been visually accepted by this report.
New scripts and their execution remain pending separate actual test and visual evidence.
